policy: The frame-difference routine produces a PIXEL HEIGHT ESTIMATE only. It is NOT a precise font-size measurement. Production QA keeps a named human font-size confirmation as a FIXED prerequisite; the automatic estimate never closes that human review item.
historical_documents: report.md / subtitle-signoff-fix.md / pipeline-status.json are left untouched; any round-1 wording that implied a real font-size measurement is corrected by declaration in addendum-round2.md, not by rewriting history.
